scope: from-zero deployment guide and offline artifact helpers
scenarios: env 0->3 preserves length/CRC and <=5 changed bytes
limitations: Pinned-board path, not every factory revision or PA/RFIC SKU.
Writer is generic and erases the whole selected MTD partition; target guard must precede execution.
Environment helper is offline only, accepts the qualified nonredundant 128-KiB format.
Full32MiB backup is required before payload write; early env change has separate affected-range backup/readback gate.
